subject: Re: MAP draft & RACI confirmation - FinServe evaluation
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finserve.com>; Tom Blake <tom.blake@finserve.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft & RACI confirmation - FinServe evaluation

Hi Elena / Tom —

Great conversation today — thanks again for the time. As promised, attached is a first-draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones we discussed and the proposed owners. High-level asks: please review the milestone owners and the target close date (we've provisionally set 2026-05-15), and confirm the economic, security, legal, and engineering owners so we can align internal resources.

Attached: FinServe_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx (MAP with milestone rows + RACI columns)
Also attached: Redwood_SOW_Template.pdf (for procurement)

Draft milestones (short):
- Pilot kickoff: internal config + env access (owner: FinServe Eng) — target 2026-03-22
- Security review & questionnaire completion (owner: FinServe Security) — target 2026-04-05
- Procurement & PO issuance (owner: FinServe Procurement) — target 2026-04-20
- Pilot validation & success criteria sign-off (owner: FinServe Product) — target 2026-05-10
- Contract execution (SOW + signature) (owner: FinServe Legal / Procurement) — target 2026-05-15

Proposed RACI mapping (high level) in the attached sheet — please confirm or propose edits. Specific asks from our side:
1) Confirm who the economic buyer is for final approvals (name + email).
2) Confirm security owner for SOC2/KMS discussions.
3) Confirm legal owner who will coordinate SOW redlines.
4) Confirm engineering lead who will own access and integration tasks.

If it's helpful, I can turn the MAP into a shared Google Sheet and add the HubSpot milestone record so both teams can track.

Next steps: once you confirm stakeholder names we'll lock owners in the MAP and set a short weekly cadence (15 min) for the pilot until procurement completes.

Thanks —
Ben
---
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0112
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finserve.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@finserve.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & RACI confirmation - FinServe evaluation

Thanks Ben — this is helpful. I reviewed the MAP and added a few notes (see inline in the attached). Quick answers below:

Economic buyer: Elena Rossi (me) — I own budget approvals for pilot and potential expansion.
Security owner: Tom Blake will own the security questionnaire and SOC2 review (tom.blake@finserve.com).
Legal owner: Procurement/legal point-of-contact is procurement@finserve.com, but primary legal reviewer will be Janet Moore (janet.moore@finserve.com). Procurement will lead PO/contract ops.
Engineering lead: Michael Chen (michael.chen@finserve.com) from Platform — he will own access and integration.

One clarification: our security team requested that we push the security review target to 2026-04-12 (one week later) because of an internal compliance blackout the week of Apr 5. Can you update the MAP accordingly? Also procurement needs a copy of Redwood's standard SOW (we have your template attached) and a ballpark for monthly spend during pilot (approx tokens/month) to estimate budget.

I'll ask procurement to initiate an internal PO request once we agree on dates and costs.

Thanks —
Elena
FinServe — Head of Data & ML
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finserve.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & RACI confirmation - FinServe evaluation

Elena — thanks for the quick confirmation and the stakeholder list. I've updated the MAP to reflect the security review shift to 2026-04-12 and added the specific names you provided. Key updates in the attached MAP (v2 -> v3):

- Security review target: 2026-04-12 (owner: Tom Blake)
- Economic buyer: Elena Rossi (confirmed)
- Legal reviewer: Janet Moore (cc procurement@finserve.com)
- Eng lead: Michael Chen (michael.chen@finserve.com)
- Pilot monthly estimate: 120k tokens/month -> estimated pilot spend $1,800/month (provisional; final depends on throughput/seq length).

Updated milestone table (high level):
1) Pilot kickoff (env access) — owner: Michael Chen (FinServe Eng) — target 2026-03-22 — R: Michael, A: Elena, C: Tom, I: Janet
2) Security questionnaire & review — owner: Tom Blake (FinServe Security) — target 2026-04-12 — R: Tom, A: Elena, C: Vivek (Redwood Security), I: Janet
3) Procurement & PO issuance — owner: procurement@finserve.com — target 2026-04-20 — R: Procurement, A: Elena, C: Ben, I: Janet
4) Pilot validation & success criteria sign-off — owner: FinServe Product — target 2026-05-10 — R: Product, A: Elena, C: Ben, I: Michael
5) Contract execution (SOW + signature) — owner: Janet Moore / procurement@finserve.com — target 2026-05-15 — R: Legal/Procurement, A: Elena, C: Ben, I: Marissa

Next steps from Redwood:
- I'll share MAP v3 (attached) and create a shared Google Sheet with a HubSpot link for milestone tracking.
- Vivek (cc'd) will provide a short security brief and the SOC2 artifact list to Tom by 2026-03-05. Vivek — can you confirm availability?
- I'll follow up with procurement on SOW redlines once Janet flags them.

If that aligns, we'll plan for weekly 15-min syncs starting 2026-03-10 to keep momentum.

Ben
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Tom Blake <tom.blake@finserve.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finserve.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & RACI confirmation - FinServe evaluation

Tom / Elena — happy to help. I can send over the SOC2 artifact checklist and sample responses by end of day 2026-03-05. Quick note on KMS/keys — we support customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) for Private deployments; for the hosted pilot we can provide encrypted-in-transit and at-rest with Redwood-managed keys, and escalate to customer-managed keys if required for production.

Action items I will take:
- Share SOC2 artifact checklist + sample answers (due 2026-03-05)
- Schedule a 30-min security sync with Tom and Michael for week of 2026-03-08
- Flag any additional technical constraints for the pilot (network/VPC, IP allowlist) in the shared MAP sheet

If procurement needs a technical contact for the SOW, please use my contact (vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com).

Thanks —
Vivek
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
summary: MAP v3 shared; stakeholders confirmed (Elena economic buyer, Tom security, Janet legal, Michael eng lead); security review target moved to 2026-04-12; Redwood to provide SOC2 artifact checklist and estimated pilot spend; next steps include weekly 15-min syncs starting 2026-03-10.
